'''Tuunac''' was the [[Prefect/Legends|prefect]] of the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii's]] largest church. Held in considerable regard by most Trianii, Tuunac visited several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] outside of [[Trian/Legends|Trian]] and its colonies as to promote goodwill and peace.
